name: 白平衡分析
description: Analyzes color temperature consistency across the image. AI images may show inconsistent white balance or unnatural color cast patterns.
algorithm: Gray World + Color Temperature Consistency Analysis
mechanism: Estimates white balance using gray world assumption and analyzes color temperature consistency across image regions.
parameters: Method: gray world, Region analysis: block-based
source: Van de Weijer et al. (2007), IEEE TIP
useCase: Detecting white balance inconsistencies in AI images

references.title: Van de Weijer, J. et al. (2007). Edge-based Color Constancy. IEEE TIP.
Riess, C. & Angelopoulou, E. (2010). Scene Illumination as an Indicator of Image Manipulation. Information Hiding.
Gijsenij, A. et al. (2011). Computational Color Constancy: Survey and Experiments. IEEE TIP.

strengths:
• Detects color temperature inconsistencies across regions
• Based on physics of illumination and surface reflectance
• Effective for composite image detection
• Multiple illuminant estimation algorithms available
• Reveals AI color cast artifacts
limitations:
• Mixed lighting scenes naturally have varying color temperatures
• Auto white balance correction normalizes results
• Narrow dynamic range reduces detection sensitivity
• Colored objects can bias regional estimates
• Post-processing color grading masks inconsistencies
